title: Baseball by Ukubot
description: An original arcade baseball game featuring first-person pitching, timing-based batting, and nine-inning exhibition games.

controls.pitching: Tap PITCH to begin the windup, move over the field to aim, then tap to release.
controls.batting: Tap SWING or press Space when the ball approaches.
controls.take: Use TAKE PITCH to let a pitch pass.
controls.pitchSelection: Use CHANGE PITCH to cycle pitch types.
